svg.text: End-to-end MLOps pipeline — from data ingestion to production monitoring
GZip → CORS → Auth → Rate Limit → Security Headers → Observability
Parallel model comparison · Agreement tracking · Safe canary deployments without user impact
JPG/PNG/WebP ≤20MB → Compress ≤4.5MB → POST /predict → Confidence card + Grad-CAM overlay → History (last 10)
Image → Resize(224) → Normalize(ImageNet) → EfficientNet-B0 → Sigmoid → {real, ai_generated}
dev (hot-reload, debug) · prod (gunicorn 4w, resource limits, health checks) · detector-network bridge
